name: vlc-player-monorepo
description: Monorepo for @lunarr/vlc-player (React Native, New Architecture) and its example app

scripts.example:prebuild:tvos: EXPO_TV=1 pnpm --filter @lunarr/example exec expo prebuild --platform ios --clean
scripts.example:ios:clean: pnpm run example:prebuild:ios && pnpm run example:ios
scripts.example:tvos:clean: pnpm run example:prebuild:tvos && pnpm run example:tvos
